chunks: By this chain of narration, from Bakr ibn Abdullah ibn Habib. He said: Atiyya ibn Ismail ibn Ibrahim al-Ansari narrated to me. He said: Abu Umara Muhammad ibn Ahmad al-Khashshab narrated to us. He said: al-Abbas ibn Yazid al-Najrani and Ishaq ibn Ibrahim al-Warraq narrated to us. They said: Dirar ibn Sard narrated to us. He said: al-Mu'tamir ibn Sulayman narrated to us, from his father, from al-Hasan, from Anas ibn Malik. He said:
The Prophet (may Allah bless him and his family) said: Ali will clarify for my nation that in which they will disagree after me.

key_terms.اختلفوا: Disagree/differ, referring to disputes in religious matters

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet Muhammad say about Ali's role in resolving disputes after him?
ai.summary: The Prophet (SAWW) declares that Ali (AS) is the authority who will resolve disagreements within the Muslim community after the Prophet's passing. This hadith, narrated through Anas ibn Malik and transmitted through al-Hasan al-Basri, underscores Ali's role as the definitive interpreter of Islamic teachings and the arbiter of disputes, affirming the concept of wilayah and Ali's unique scholarly authority.

en.bilal-muhammad: By this isnad from Bakr b. `Abdullah b. Habib. He said: `Atiyya b. Isma`il b. Ibrahim al-Ansari narrated to me. He said: Abu `Amira Muhammad b. Ahmad al-Khashab narrated to us. He said: Al-`Abbas b. Yazid al-Najrani and Ishaq b. Ibrahim al-Warraq narrated to us. They said: Dirar b. Sard narrated to us. He said: al-Mu`tamar b. Sulayman narrated to us from his father from al-Hasan from Anas b. Malik. He said:
The Prophet (s) said: `Ali will clarify that which my Nation will disagree about after me.
